name: Nexus International School (Singapore)
summary: IB World School in Aljunied with a learner-centred approach.
body: Nexus Singapore delivers IB programmes with an emphasis on personalised learning. The Aljunied location works for east and central-east households. Compare fees, class sizes, and secondary pathways carefully against larger IB campuses.
